// diagnostic

E1304

`parse` expects 1 argument (argv), got N

What

`parse` expects 1 argument (argv), got N

Why

`ArgsSpec.parse(argv)` parses a `[String]` against the spec; pass exactly the argv list.

Fix

Pass exactly one argument: the argv list, e.g. `spec.parse(io.args())`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1304: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_parse_arity.stderr.

Error [E1304]: `parse` expects 1 argument (argv), got 2
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_parse_arity.jet:6:20
    |
  6 |     parsed :: spec.parse(process.argv(), "extra") ?? panic("parse failed")
    |                    ^^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.parse(argv)` parses a `[String]` (from `process.argv()`) against the spec
 Fix: pass exactly one argument: the argv list, e.g. `process.argv()`
